sources.label: Patches for morphe
sources.author: Hooman
patch_list: Unlocks Hevy's Pro features without a subscription, like unlimited routines and advanced workout analytics. They run on the workout data on your device. Anything Hevy serves only to subscribed accounts can still stay locked.

sources.label: Custom Morphe patches by heval99
sources.author: Heval
patch_list: Disables analytics, tracking and crash reporting.
Unlocks Pro features. Server features like Hevy Coach stay locked.

sources.label: Standalone, app-specific patches for use with Morphe
sources.author: kveld9 Extra
patch_list: Blocks crash reporting, ad attribution and referral tracking.
Deletes tutorial videos, editor stickers and junk to shrink the app.
Stops background sync tasks and alarms that drain the battery.
Unlocks Pro features stored on the device (routines, folders, charts). Server-limited items may still need a subscription.
